entries.name: Java 8+ API desugaring support
entries.note: The Classpath Exception removes the copyleft effect of linking, so using this library does not oblige us to release the application source. The exception must be named alongside the GPL or the entry reads as a stronger obligation than it is.

entries.name: Glide
entries.note: Compound licence: BSD-2-Clause for Glide itself, Apache-2.0 for third_party/disklrucache, MIT for third_party/gif_decoder, plus two permissive grants in third_party/gif_encoder that have no SPDX identifier.

entries.name: PhotoView
entries.note: Published on JitPack under the original author coordinate; the canonical repository is Baseflow/PhotoView.

entries.name: JSch (mwiede fork)
entries.note: The POM declares three licences: BSD-3-Clause for JSch, BSD-3-Clause for the bundled JZlib, ISC for the bundled jBCrypt.

entries.name: NewPipe Extractor
entries.note: Copyleft without a linking exception, linked only into the sideload-only noLegal build. GPLv3 also obliges providing the corresponding source to recipients of that build - tracked as S1563.

entries.name: ZXing Core
entries.note: Licence inherited from the zxing-parent POM; the core artifact declares no licences block of its own.

entries.name: SMBJ
entries.note: Apache-2.0 per the repository LICENSE_HEADER and the licences block of the 0.12.1 POM. The LGPL sometimes associated with SMB clients on Android belongs to jcifs-ng, a different library this project does not use.

entries.name: Tesseract4Android
entries.note: Bundles Tesseract OCR (Apache-2.0) and Leptonica (BSD-2-Clause) as native libraries.

entries.name: epub4j
entries.note: Apache-2.0 per the repository LICENSE and the 4.2 POM. The upstream epublib project this is forked from declares LGPL in its parent POM, which is why the two are sometimes conflated.

entries.name: FFmpeg (custom Media3 decoder build)
entries.note: Built from FFmpeg sources by scripts/builders/build-ffmpeg-dts.sh and shipped as app_v2/libs/fms-ffmpeg-dts.aar. Its configure invocation passes neither --enable-gpl nor --enable-nonfree and disables postproc, the GPL component, so the produced binary is LGPL-2.1-or-later.

entries.name: Bouncy Castle Provider
entries.note: Published as the "Bouncy Castle Licence"; the text is verbatim MIT with their copyright, so scanners report NOASSERTION and the identifier is set by hand.

entries.name: OpenXR Loader for Android
entries.note: Loader sources carry Apache-2.0 OR MIT. The shipped native library statically links jsoncpp (MIT), jnipp (MIT) and android-jni-wrappers (BSL-1.0).

entries.name: NanoHTTPD
entries.note: Licence inherited from the nanohttpd-project POM; the artifact declares no licences block of its own.
